sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns the latest known file size for one viewer tab.
sites.justification: Explicit viewer refresh can update the size after the file grows, and page controls need that value without sharing mutable state outside the viewer object.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns stale-callback generation for one viewer tab.
sites.justification: Navigation, search, and line-jump callbacks can overlap; a small generation token drops stale async page results after mode or request changes.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns the current byte-window offset.
sites.justification: Previous/next page controls need the current offset between callbacks without sharing mutable state outside the viewer object.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns the next complete UTF-8 page boundary.
sites.justification: Next-page navigation must avoid splitting valid UTF-8 codepoints across pages while still keeping the current page read bounded.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns the active page or line-jump cancellable.
sites.justification: Replacing a viewer request cancels the previous Gio operation and prevents stale results from mutating the page buffer.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns the active streaming-search cancellable.
sites.justification: Search is a cancellable async Gio byte scan; the viewer stores only the current cancellable so a new search can stop the old one.

sites.ownership: The chunked editor apply source owns the pending document, cursor offset, and restore state for one load.
sites.justification: Idle ticks resume bounded buffer insertion across main-loop turns, while generation checks and source removal cancel the state before it can mutate a stale or closing tab.

sites.ownership: The chunked editor apply source owns the pending completion state for one load.
sites.justification: Finish restores editability and undo state from the same main-thread confined pending apply record before applying the final document presentation and one-shot callback.

sites.ownership: The large-file preferences controller owns a local syncing guard for its rows.
sites.justification: SpinRow normalization writes sanitized values back to widgets; the guard prevents those local widget updates from becoming recursive settings writes.

sites.ownership: The large-file preferences controller owns a local syncing guard for row synchronization.
sites.justification: Grouped threshold sanitization updates multiple rows together while keeping the updates GTK-main-thread local and non-recursive.

sites.ownership: The large-file viewer owns short-lived cancellable slots for mutually exclusive viewer operations.
sites.justification: The helper takes and cancels the current Gio cancellable before a page, search, or line-jump operation installs its replacement.

sites.ownership: The reader unit test owns one local callback result cell for one temporary Gio read.
sites.justification: The cell is scoped to a test-only thread-default MainContext and is completed by a single async read callback before the helper returns.

sites.ownership: The search unit test owns one local callback result cell for one temporary streaming search.
sites.justification: The cell is scoped to a test-only thread-default MainContext and is completed by the cancellable search callback before the helper returns.

sites.ownership: The tab-transfer GTK regression test borrows the test app window registry.
sites.justification: The helper needs the existing test-owned AppState only to observe that a large-file viewer tab transfer creates a destination window and preserves the viewer surface.
